counterevidence.implication: The main report notes unknown vital status and loss to follow-up, qualifying completeness of outcome ascertainment but not changing the ITT target or time-to-first-event comparison.

assessments.population_justification: The target is all randomized eligible HFrEF patients. The primary analysis used ITT and data through the planned treatment period for all randomized patients. Eligibility was adults with chronic NYHA II–IV HF and LVEF ≤40%, receiving appropriate HF therapy; this is the randomized trial population, not an external disease population.
assessments.scope_justification: This is the requested primary composite: cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure, analyzed as time to first event, with a reported HR of 0.75 (95% CI, 0.65 to 0.86). The supplement's event criteria confirm that HF hospitalization entails new or worsening symptoms and objective evidence of worsening HF, matching the target's worsening-HF hospitalization. The target follows participants from randomization for the full trial follow-up, rather than estimating fixed-duration risk; median follow-up was 16 months. Event totals were 361/1863 versus 462/1867. The Cox-model ITT comparison corresponds to assignment to empagliflozin versus placebo.
unknowns: The report states 21 patients had unknown vital status at trial end and 42 were lost to follow-up at various times; the extent and handling of missing primary outcome ascertainment are not fully detailed in the main report.
Follow-up was not a fixed duration for each patient; the main report gives median follow-up of 16 months.

applicability.rationale: The randomized double-blind trial assigned patients 1:1 to empagliflozin or placebo in parallel groups; the report describes patients as individually randomized.

reported.analysis_population: All 3730 randomized patients (1863 empagliflozin; 1867 placebo), analyzed by intention-to-treat using data through the end of the planned treatment period.

comparison_groups.assignment: Empagliflozin (10 mg once daily) in addition to usual therapy for heart failure
Placebo in addition to usual therapy for heart failure

measurement.method: First occurrence of adjudicated cardiovascular death or hospitalization for worsening heart failure; the hospitalization definition requires an adjudicated primary HF diagnosis, documented new or worsening HF symptoms, and objective new or worsening HF evidence.

time_point_or_window.description: From randomization through the entire duration of trial follow-up (median follow-up 16 months); not a fixed-duration event risk.
